column18: Huh7.zip bundles two Thermo .raw members (verified from the ZIP central directory by HTTP range read): 'Huh7/Huh7-GP73 pull down.raw' (anti-GOLM1/GP73 immunoprecipitation) and 'Huh7/Huh7-IgG pull down.raw' (IgG control). PRIDE defines Huh7.zip as a single run file, so both raws map to this one sample row; the IP/control distinction is not encoded as separate SDRF rows.
